Title: Azure Service Operator stable release version 2.0 now available

Body.Content:
Azure Service Operator project is now available with the stable release of version 2.0. It is an open-source project that allows you to create and manage over 100 Azure resources, such as databases, storage accounts, virtual machines, and more from within Kubernetes. Azure Service Operator is an ideal solution for developers who want to use Azure resources but prefer to manage those resources using Kubernetes tooling and primitives.

To get started with Azure Service Operator, you can visit our documentation page where you will find installation instructions, samples, and more. We welcome your feedback and contributions to this project.
